I've just got this: ``` - --gas-limit=150000000 - --builder-proposals ``` enabled on my vc it should be that but one sec im double checking `ssh devops@lighthouse-geth-2.srv.glamsterdam-devnet-3.ethpandaops.io` looks like all lh nodes have stopped building any blocks those flags are correct btw Compliance tests status: ✅ Teku ❓ WIP: Lighthouse ❓ WIP: Prysm 🧠 comments resolved: Lodestar 🧠 closed in favour of own PR: Nimbus ❓Grandine if you want to test, these test vectors have been generated today: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/25469914873 this is compliance test with alpha 7? asked to confirm yeah alpha.7 compliant so we still reject some payloads due to: ``` Rejecting invalid execution payload at slot 5980 with builder 18446744073709551615 and block root 0x410b53b7b71b5b8f21b699211c9937da931fd0e6201cf7efc2511ccb7448e8e7 because FAILED_VERIFICATION ........ ExecutionPayloadVerificationException: Withdrawals of the envelope are not consistent with the expected withdrawals in the state ``` is that a known thing? We reject those too this seems to be a teku self-build payload went through lodestar logs to find rejected payloads (also shown as orphaned by dora), it seems to be all self build by either nimbus or teku, see https://gist.github.com/nflaig/5647e048594d21d2a24970d67dfc791a oh.. interesting... for some reason i was assuming it was a builder issue. we'll take a look. can we spam devnet3 with lots of builder deposits per block? I'm doing a test in kt alreayd breaking teku 500+ builder deposit thread this devnet doesn't have blobs yet right? right issue identified, we will work on a fix
